title: Building Production-Ready MCP Servers for AI Applications and Agents
subtitle: How Go and Google ADK reshape agentic system design
description: Tools, resources and prompts are three different cost and trust boundaries, not three names for the same thing. Built live against a Go MCP server for running a meetup — a concurrency-safe store, one real GitHub call, and a Google ADK agent scoped down to a read-only subset of its own toolset.
